sara (security): heads up, audit job flagged ~2k backup objects in staging missing CMK metadata :eyes:
encops-bot: ALERT: storage-integrity-checker found 2,014 objects without `x-amz-server-side-encryption`/cmk-id in s3://redwood-staging-backups/2026-03/ :warning:

mike (encops): when did the audit job run? can you paste the detection query?

sara (security): just ran at 17:12 UTC. query: ```
# cloudtrail / cloudwatch Logs Insights
fields @timestamp, eventName, requestParameters.key
| filter eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com" and eventName = "PutObject"
| parse requestParameters.headers as headers
| filter not(headers like /x-amz-server-side-encryption/)
| stats count() by requestParameters.key
```

sara (security): sample keys: backups/tenant-17/2026-03-22-enc.tar.gz, snapshots/tenant-42/2026-03-21-part1.snappy

dana (sre): that path looks like the new uploader service. we rolled a rename last week -> svc-backup-uploader-v2? could be RBAC/service-account fallout.

mike (encops): +1. there was an IAM prune on Mar 18 that removed legacy uploader role. maybe new uploader lost kms:Encrypt permission or the uploader switched to SSE-S3 fallback.

kevin (platform): checking deploy logs now. i see a migration on Mar 19 that toggled `USE_CMEK=true` -> `false` in the uploader helm chart for quick rollback test. ops forgot to reapply the kyverno policy that injects CMK headers.

sara (security): oh — so it's config drift not KMS itself. but we still have objects without encryption metadata. we need triage: which tenants affected, can we re-encrypt, and is there any risk of keys being missing on restore?

mike (encops): quick answers:
- tenants: likely subset that used uploader-v2. will enumerate via tag filter.
- re-encrypt: S3-side re-encrypt with CMK is possible (copy with SSE-KMS header) if object ACLs allow and CMK grants exist.
- restore risk: if object truly unencrypted, restore works but violates policy; if encrypted with SSE-S3 then no KMS dependency. main risk is audit/compliance failure.

encops-bot: DETECTED: missing-cmek-objects >= 1000 in staging. created ticket INC-20260322-1 and query snapshot at s3://alerts/missing-cmek-20260322.json

dana (sre): action plan proposal:
1) revoke public/backups-uploader temporary rollback by adding a deny rule on the svcaccount (prevent further unencrypted uploads)
2) run targeted copy-rewrite to apply `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms` with CMK using a short TTL grant (audit the copy)
3) create per-tenant report and notify compliance
4) add CI check to prevent `USE_CMEK=false` merge to main

kevin (platform): for step 2 we need kms:GenerateDataKey permission and grant on the CMK. do we want to use ephemeral grants via KMS Grants API? avoids policy change risk.

mike (encops): yes ephemeral grants are safer. flow:
- create grant to CMK with Encrypt, GenerateDataKey for a service principal for the rewriter job
- rewriter runs and copies objects with `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms`, `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id: <cmk>`
- revoke grant after job completes

sara (security): also need audit trail: log each copy with a correlation id and append to our compliance S3 bucket. include object checksum and previous metadata.

kevin (platform): i'm on grants. creating a script to batch 500 objects/min, with a dry-run first. will open PR to infra repo.

mike (encops): temporary mitigation: re-enable kyverno/injector webhook for uploader namespace and force redeploy with `USE_CMEK=true`. that prevents new bad objects while we reencrypt existing ones.

dana (sre): can someone run a restore test from one of the affected tenant backups after re-encrypt? we should verify decrypt path and restore time. assign to me if OK.

sara (security): pls also add a compliance note for SOC team. i'll draft the email and add the tenant list when kevin posts it.

kevin (platform): initial tenant list: tenant-17, tenant-42, tenant-83, tenant-101. full list in INC-20260322-1. uploading CSV now.

mike (encops): heads up — found one edge: multipart uploads older than 30 days may not be eligible for simple copy re-encrypt; we'll need to re-assemble as part copy/part rewrite. tagging as follow-up in the ticket.

sara (security): good catch. mark P1 for compliance.

encops-bot: NOTE: automated mitigation applied — `uploader-v2` namespace webhook re-enabled at 18:05 UTC.

dana (sre): i'll run a restore validation on tenant-42 after rewriter finishes. ETA ~2h.

mike (encops): i'll coordinate the rewriter grants and post logs to the ticket. will also add a guardrail check to the uploader helm chart that will fail CI if `USE_CMEK=false` and namespace is prod/staging.

kevin (platform): PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/432 — includes grant script and batcher.

sara (security): thanks all. keep updates in INC-20260322-1. after re-encrypt complete let's run an audit to confirm zero missing CMK headers. :white_check_mark:

kevin (platform): noted. will update ticket when batch 1 completes.

mike (encops): closing loop: postmortem template should include preventive measures: RBAC review before IAM prune, config-flag CI gate, and an automated detection alert for missing CMK headers (already done).

sara (security): agree. assigning postmortem to me.

encops-bot: Incident INC-20260322-1 updated: mitigation in progress.
